why: Most commands are fine: `node bin/greet.js --shout Ada`, `npm test` (the script is `node --test`), `cat`/`grep -n -- --shout docs/index.md`, `gh pr view <number> --json state,mergedAt` and `curl -sSL …` are all valid and name files that exist. The builder brief's commands are fine too. Check 2 in the verifier brief breaks the criterion. It gives "`git stash`-free: `git worktree add` or `git show <base>:bin/greet.js` with src/greet.js from base". `git worktree add` with no path is missing a required argument, so it fails with a usage error. `git show <base>:bin/greet.js` only prints the file's contents. It does not run the base version, and the brief gives no runnable steps for running the base with src/greet.js from base. So the base comparison command would not run as written.
